legacyStatisticsCache: FIE legacy initialize only captures at terminal for isExplainAnalyze||dynamicEnabled, and ordinary fixed-one with both disabled has no frozen stats.
statisticsRpc: Manager returns NOT_FOUND actual response if execution absent and context.statistics null, or context absent; it preserves FI ID and EXECUTE_STATEMENT_ERROR.
infoRpc: Separate normal context cache still supports real state/endTime. getInstanceInfo returnsnull if absent/cancellationRequested; RPC mapsnull to NO_SUCH_INSTANCE.
controlGuard: Explicit opt-in, real profile/config hashes and disabled feature flags. Never infer missing=0.
scope: Explicit observation capability contract, not executed service results.

cancellationTerminalPolicy.rule: CANCELLED requires exact live targeted KILL acknowledgment, real source activity, exact SQL code 715, every FI frozen terminal and actual resource/pool settlement; it does not require a non-FINISHED FI.
cancellationTerminalPolicy.reason: Existing one-second termination grace permits graceful FI completion while result close propagates; deadline and exception still require at least one non-success FI.
cancellationTerminalPolicy.negativeMutation: Omitting real KILL but fabricating acknowledgment is rejected because SQL did not return exact 715.
